page.overview:
Who is Cassandra?

A Sorceress of Ghrond, Cassandra was loyal to Morathi in the same way her lover, Dorian Silverblade, was to Malekith - though such loyalties generally meant nothing. The mother and the son shared information about their minions even as they maneuvered for advantage against each other. Such has been the way in Naggaroth for millennia.

In this, Cassandra was as much spying on Dorian for Morathi as Dorian was her to Malekith. Dorian reported their contact with one another as soon as it happened, if only to avoid punishment from the Witch King. It was the way the realm functioned.
